title: Regen rpl_messages.json DODAGID to upstream AddrForKey via generate.py (1 red)
description: 1p2r child. tests/test_protocol_vector_security.py::test_root_vectors_use_native_addr_for_key_and_independent_signatures fails (assert at :466-469) because test/vectors/rpl_messages.json still encodes native-profile DODAGID for seed 0x00*32 while the assertion compares against the now-upstream reference ReferenceIdentity.from_seed().ygg_addr (reference rewired in beads-worker-6 commit eff0f51f8a; on main the module is still native so this test passes there until that lands). Fix: regenerate rpl_messages.json via test/vectors/generate.py rpl_messages builder so its DODAGID equals upstream AddrForKey; expected oracle value 020224ae... (verify with live yggdrasil-go, never impl-derived). Keep the assertion unchanged — never weaken.
